//: Every dependency here is declared as an ARG carrying a `# renovate:` comment. One custom manager covers all of them; adding a tool means adding an ARG, not editing this file.

packageRules.description: Base image ships ~104 stable releases/yr (~2/week). Batch into one weekly PR rather than nine a month, and never take a beta.
Pinned CLI binaries. Combined cadence is ~30-60/yr, so one grouped weekly PR keeps it to ~1 rebuild a week.

//2: The npm CLIs (claude-code, gemini-cli, codex, todoist-cli, mcporter, clawhub) are deliberately NOT pinned in the Dockerfile and therefore invisible to Renovate. Their cadence makes tracking impractical: codex ~3600 releases/yr, gemini-cli ~630, claude-code ~316. They refresh whenever the floating layer rebuilds.
